description: Unit conversion across 14 categories with exact defined factors: length, mass, volume (US and imperial), area, speed, time, data (SI kB vs IEC KiB, bits vs bytes), pressure, energy, power, angle, frequency, temperature (C, F, K, Rankine) and fuel economy (mpg US/UK, L/100 km, km/L). Common names and abbreviations accepted; optionally lists the value in every unit of the category. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/unit-convert

all.description: Also return the value in every unit of the category

from.description: Source unit, e.g. mi, kg, F, GiB, psi, mpg
